title: Rakvor curated Colombian trust list: one CSV row
description: The curated CSV of ONAC-accredited entidades de certificación digital (ECD) imported by `rv-certcheck trust-list import --list co`. The file is RFC 4180 CSV, UTF-8 (optional BOM), whose header is exactly these nine column names (any order); each row, read as an object keyed by the header, must validate against this schema. One row is one status period of one service (ecd_name + service_name + service_type); a service with several CA certificates has one row per certificate. Implementation and full rules: src/certs/src/trustlist/co.rs.

time.description: RFC 3339 (2025-01-01T00:00:00Z, any offset; converted to UTC) or a date YYYY-MM-DD (midnight UTC).

ecd_name.description: The ECD (trust service provider) as accredited by ONAC.

service_type.description: CA/QC (issues certificates for firma digital), TSA (estampado cronológico) or another short type.

status_until.description: End of the status period; empty when still current.

certificate_pem_or_b64.description: One CA certificate: a PEM block (quoted, newlines allowed) or base64 DER on one line. Empty for a row that only records a status period.

source_url.description: Where the accreditation was checked (the ONAC page).

checked_utc.description: When the curator checked the row. The snapshot's issue_date is the latest of these.
